description: Retrieval evaluation set for backend/docs. expected_sources lists every doc that contains information needed to answer; it is empty when the docs do not answer the question. Categories: single (one doc answers it), multi (needs more than one doc), ambiguous (vague question; any listed doc is a reasonable match), unanswerable (on-topic but not in the docs), out_of_scope (not about Flowspace).
